title: OF5 -- Settings: Add font beside the Interface font menu, hidden file input, one line before General
description: Screenshots 6.png (Settings dialog opened from the Projects page), 7.png (Settings inside a project), 9.png (two grey lines). Owner, three points: (1) 'the add font and choose files on the settings in the project page isn't right': in the dialog the hidden file input shows as 'Choose Files' and the Add font button is a tall box; cause to confirm: '.dialog input' in src/styles.css:1255 sets a display that defeats the hidden attribute; fix it inside src/settings/appearance-settings.css (do not edit styles.css) and make the button look the same as in project Settings. (2) 'the add font within the project has a whole line for it. Does it need it? ... reduce the horizontal length of the interface font and put the add font button there': put the Add font button on the same row as the Interface font dropdown, to its right, with the dropdown narrower; in both places Settings appears. (3) 'within project settings, there are two grey lines instead of one before general': the section strip's bottom border plus the first section's top border; show one line; fix in src/settings/settings-nav.css only. New spec tests/of5-settings.spec.ts (file input not visible in the dialog; button and dropdown share a row in both contexts; exactly one rule between the strip and General), shown failing first. Port 1455. Owner hand-test report 2026-11-11 (he tried the real app; his report outranks any passing test). Rules: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/w9-brief.md, with notes in docs/agent-work/2026-11-11-owner-fixes/notes/<task>.md instead of the wave 9 notes folder. Before your first browser run, grep tests/ for every selector, label and class you change and update the specs that pin them (register each first). Run unit tests and tsc before any trip through the serial lock. Do not edit docs/*.md or AGENTS.md. No commits.

handoff.text: r2 reject, one CSS fix (behaviour is right: hidden input, one row in both places, one rule before General; of5 4/4, w9-fonts, w9-settings-nav pass in reviewer run). src/settings/appearance-settings.css '.appearance-fonts .settings-button' copies the shared button look (padding, border, background, color, justify-content) plus font-size and a literal line-height 1.5, on the stated premise that '.project-settings .settings-button' (research.css:507) does not reach the Projects dialog. That premise is false: the dialog wraps the same block in div.project-settings.library-settings-body (ProjectLibrary.tsx ~481), so the shared rule already applies there. The real cause of the tall box was the label wrapping ('Add / font...') plus the visible file input. Fix: 1) delete padding, border, background, color, font-size, line-height and justify-content from that rule and the wrong comment; keep only 'flex: none; white-space: nowrap;' (and the input display:none rule). 2) Rerun of5-settings: if the dialog height still differs by more than 1 px, set only the differing inherited property on '.library-settings-body .appearance-fonts .settings-button' using a token, and say which. Keyboard path is fine (real button, input.click() in the same gesture). Pre-existing, not yours: '.project-settings .settings-button' colour also overrides '.appearance-fonts__remove' red in both places. See REVIEW-r2.md.
